Era Guide

1. Starting Era

2026 Current Day loads the real 30-team alignment and a current core-roster snapshot.

Choose a historical starting point. 1976 remains the full long-form historical simulation; 2026 now uses a dedicated current-day 30-team roster snapshot. Additional era snapshots will continue to be expanded.

2. Choose Your Role

🏛 CommissionerRun the league: expansion, relocation, alignment, rules.
👑 OwnerRun the organization: executives, finances, arena, direction.
🏀 GMBuild the roster: draft, trades, contracts, staff.
📋 CoachWin with the roster: rotations, roles, strategy, development.
👁 ViewerWatch the universe unfold without required decisions or team-management responsibilities.
⭐ PlayerLive one career: training, relationships, contracts, and legacy.
